scope: Independent complete-HTML VM adversarial review; source and span substitutions plus positive ordinary edit. Not a clean extraction gate or browser/physical acceptance.

results.name: Decoded tiles cannot be relabeled as a different physical source by shared encoding
A source-bound tile span cannot be replaced by a one-byte iNES header range
A same-length but unrelated span cannot replace the decoded physical tile selection
